name: Huawei Cloud ECS

evidence.vps: 03: rented provider-hosted virtual machines; the customer manages the guest OS, runtime and app

line: Run virtual machines and manage the operating system and apps.

free.text: No recurring always-free ECS allowance established

cells.regions: Singapore, Hong Kong and other China/overseas regions

work.math: The Singapore T6 compute reference is $6.13 a month. Rates for disk, 100 GB of data sent out, builds and CI, and the domain are missing.
The Singapore T6 compute reference, with 1 vCPU and 1 GiB, is $6.13 a month. 100 GB of data sent out, disk and other costs are not priced. Throughput is untested.
The Hong Kong C6s compute reference is $42.25 a month. Add disk, self-managed PostgreSQL, daily 7-day backups and traffic charges.
